words.note: 當 reread 只是最直接地表示把同一份文字再讀一次時，可用 read again。它語氣中性，適合書、文章、電郵、訊息和說明。
words.example: I read the email again to make sure I had understood it correctly.
words.exampleZh: 我把電郵再讀一次，確保自己理解正確。

exercises.original: I reread the message because I thought I might have misunderstood the final sentence.
exercises.zh: 我把訊息再讀一次，因為我以為自己可能誤解了最後一句。
exercises.upgrade: read it again · 再讀一次；重新閱讀

options.explanation: reviewed = 複習／重新檢視。也可以，但語氣帶有檢查或評估意味；本句只需直接表達再讀一次。
read it again = 再讀一次。might have misunderstood 是最直接的重讀原因，因此最自然。
revisited the text = 回頭再看文本。較正式，也較像重新思考內容。
went back over it = 回頭再看一遍。也很接近，但本句最簡單直接的替換是 read again。
looked it over again = 再檢查一遍。較偏快速查看或檢查。
skimmed = 略讀。只是快速抓重點，不等於重新完整閱讀。

exercises.original: She reread the last chapter before starting the sequel.
exercises.zh: 她開始讀續集前，把最後一章再讀了一次。
exercises.upgrade: read the last chapter again · 再讀一次；重新閱讀

options.explanation: revisited the argument = 重新思考論點。chapter 在這裡是小說內容，不是論證。
reviewed for an exam = 為考試複習。沒有考試語境。
read the last chapter again = 再讀最後一章。before starting the sequel 清楚表示她重新閱讀同一章。
looked over notes = 查看筆記。材料不同。
went back over instructions = 再看說明。材料不同。
proofread = 校對。不是為理解內容而重讀。

exercises.original: Please reread the instructions if any part of the procedure is unclear.
exercises.zh: 如果程序有任何部分不清楚，請把說明再讀一次。
exercises.upgrade: read the instructions again · 再讀一次；重新閱讀

options.explanation: skim the instructions = 略讀說明。若內容不清楚，略讀通常不足以解決問題。
review the whole course = 複習整個課程。範圍完全不合。
revisit the novel = 重看小說。材料錯誤。
read the instructions again = 再讀一次說明。if any part... is unclear 是最直接重讀語境。
proofread the instructions = 校對說明。重點會變成找錯字，而不是重新理解程序。
summarise them = 摘要。不是重讀本身。

words.note: 當 reread 的目的不是單純再看一次，而是為了複習、檢查、鞏固理解或準備考試時，可用 review。它常接 notes, material, chapter, document 等。
words.example: She reviewed her notes before the test.

exercises.original: The students reread their notes before the exam to make sure they remembered the key ideas.
exercises.zh: 學生在考試前重新閱讀筆記，確保記得主要概念。

options.explanation: read again casually = 隨意再讀。before the exam 和 remember the key ideas 表示有明確複習目的，不只是隨便再看。
reviewed = 複習／重新檢視。notes + before the exam 是最典型的 review 語境。
revisited the story = 重看故事。材料和目的不合。
went back over the email = 再看電郵。材料錯誤。
looked over the menu = 查看餐牌。完全不合。
skimmed = 略讀。只快速看，不足以表示有系統複習。

exercises.original: Before the meeting, she reread the report and checked the figures one more time.
exercises.zh: 會議前，她重新檢視報告，並再核對一次數字。

options.explanation: revisited the novel = 重讀小說。材料錯誤。
reviewed = 重新檢視。report + checked the figures 表示有檢查與確認目的。
read the headline again = 只再看標題。範圍太窄。
skimmed only = 只略讀。和 checked the figures 不符。
proofread for spelling only = 只校對拼字。題目重點是內容與數字，而非語言錯誤。
ignored = 忽略。意思相反。

exercises.original: He reread the vocabulary list every evening so the new words would stay fresh in his memory.
exercises.zh: 他每天晚上都重讀詞彙表，讓新詞保持熟悉。

options.explanation: reviewed = 複習。every evening + stay fresh in his memory 明確是反覆複習以鞏固記憶。
revisited the argument = 重看論點。材料不合。
looked over the map = 查看地圖。材料不合。
went back over the contract = 再看合約。材料不合。
read the novel again = 再讀小說。完全不同。
proofread = 校對。不是記憶詞彙。

words.meaning: 重新回看文本；再次思考文本內容
words.note: 當 reread 指回到先前讀過的文本，重新思考其含義、論點、細節或解釋時，可用 revisit the text。它常見於學術、文學和分析語境。
words.example: We revisited the text after discussing the author's argument.
words.exampleZh: 討論作者的論點後，我們重新回看了文本。

exercises.original: After the class discussion, students reread the passage to see whether their interpretation had changed.
exercises.zh: 課堂討論後，學生重新回看文章，看看自己的理解是否有所改變。
exercises.upgrade: revisited the text · 重新回看文本；再次思考文本內容

options.explanation: read it again mechanically = 機械式再讀。題目強調 interpretation had changed，並非只是重複閱讀。
reviewed for spelling = 為拼字作檢查。目的不合。
revisited the text = 重新回看文本。after discussion + interpretation 是典型重新思考文本語境。
looked over the timetable = 查看時間表。材料錯誤。
went back over a receipt = 再看收據。材料錯誤。
skimmed = 略讀。不能表示重新深入思考理解。

exercises.original: The essay asks students to reread the poem in light of the historical context they have just learned.
exercises.zh: 這篇文章要求學生在剛學到的歷史背景下重新閱讀這首詩。
exercises.upgrade: revisit the text · 重新回看文本；再次思考文本內容

options.explanation: review the timetable = 檢視時間表。材料完全不合。
read again for pleasure = 為消閒再讀。題目有明確分析目的。
revisit the text = 重新回看文本。in light of new historical context 正是重新詮釋的語境。
proofread the poem = 校對詩。不是找錯字。
skim the poem = 略讀。和分析語境不合。
look over a form = 查看表格。材料不合。

exercises.original: When the new evidence appeared, the researcher reread the original interview transcript with a different question in mind.
exercises.zh: 新證據出現後，研究員帶着不同問題重新回看原本的訪談逐字稿。
exercises.upgrade: revisited the text · 重新回看文本；再次思考文本內容

options.explanation: revisited the text = 重新回看文本。new evidence + a different question in mind 表示帶着新角度重新閱讀。
reviewed for an exam = 為考試複習。沒有考試。
read the menu again = 再看餐牌。材料錯誤。
proofread punctuation = 校對標點。目的不合。
skimmed headlines = 瀏覽標題。不是仔細回看逐字稿。
looked over instructions = 查看說明。材料不合。

words.meaning: 回頭再看一遍；重新檢查
words.note: 當 reread 指回頭把先前看過的內容再過一遍，通常為了確認細節、找出遺漏或加深理解時，可用 go back over。這是很自然的口語片語。
words.example: Let's go back over the instructions before we start.
words.exampleZh: 開始前，我們再把說明看一遍。

exercises.original: Before submitting the form, he reread every answer to make sure nothing had been missed.
exercises.zh: 提交表格前，他把每個答案再看一遍，確保沒有遺漏。
exercises.upgrade: went back over every answer · 回頭再看一遍；重新檢查

options.explanation: reviewed the textbook = 複習教科書。材料完全不合。
revisited the novel = 重讀小說。材料不合。
went back over every answer = 回頭逐一再看。make sure nothing had been missed 是最典型的檢查語境。
read a new version = 讀新版本。不是同一內容再看。
skimmed = 略讀。為避免遺漏需要較仔細查看。
memorised = 背誦。不是重讀本身。

exercises.original: The lawyer reread the witness statement line by line before questioning him.
exercises.zh: 律師在盤問證人前，把證供逐行再看一遍。
exercises.upgrade: went back over the statement · 回頭再看一遍；重新檢查

options.explanation: read it again for pleasure = 為娛樂再讀。法律準備語境不合。
went back over the statement = 回頭再看證供。line by line + before questioning 表示仔細重新檢查。
reviewed vocabulary = 複習詞彙。材料不合。
skimmed it = 略讀。和 line by line 相反。
revisited a poem = 重看詩。材料錯誤。
summarised it = 摘要。不是再次閱讀。

exercises.original: We should reread the calculations before sending the figures to the client.
exercises.zh: 把數字發給客戶前，我們應該把計算再檢查一遍。
exercises.upgrade: go back over the calculations · 回頭再看一遍；重新檢查

options.explanation: skim the calculations = 略看計算。數字核對通常需要更仔細。
review the novel = 複習小說。材料不合。
revisit the article = 重看文章。材料不合。
read them aloud = 朗讀。未必能核實計算。
go back over the calculations = 回頭再檢查計算。before sending figures to the client 明確是核對細節。
ignore them = 忽略。意思相反。

words.note: 當 reread 指較輕量地把文件、筆記、電郵或內容再查看一遍，通常為了快速確認時，可用 look over again。它比 review 稍口語，也通常沒那麼深入。
words.example: Could you look over the email again before I send it?
words.exampleZh: 我寄出前，你可以再看一次這封電郵嗎？

exercises.original: Could you reread this email before I send it and tell me if the tone sounds too direct?
exercises.zh: 我寄出前，你可以再看一次這封電郵，告訴我語氣是否太直接嗎？
exercises.upgrade: look it over again · 再看一遍；重新查看

options.explanation: revisit the novel = 重看小說。材料完全不合。
review for an exam = 為考試複習。目的不合。
look it over again = 再看一遍。before I send it + check the tone 是典型快速重新查看。
skim unrelated notes = 瀏覽無關筆記。完全不合。
memorise it = 背熟。不是檢查語氣。
rewrite from memory = 憑記憶重寫。不是重讀。

exercises.original: She reread the timetable before leaving the house to confirm the departure time.
exercises.zh: 她離家前再看一次時間表，確認出發時間。
exercises.upgrade: looked the timetable over again · 再看一遍；重新查看

options.explanation: looked the timetable over again = 再查看時間表。confirm the departure time 表示快速核對資訊，非常自然。
revisited the argument = 重看論點。材料不合。
reviewed vocabulary = 複習詞彙。材料不合。
proofread it = 校對。不是找語言錯誤。
read a novel again = 再讀小說。無關。
skimmed a report = 略讀報告。材料錯誤。

exercises.original: I reread my notes quickly before the phone call just to remind myself of the main points.
exercises.zh: 打電話前，我快速再看一次筆記，只為提醒自己主要重點。
exercises.upgrade: looked my notes over again · 再看一遍；重新查看

options.explanation: reviewed intensively = 深入複習。題目說 quickly 和 just to remind myself，力度太重。
revisited the text deeply = 深入重新思考文本。目的過於分析性。
went back over every detail = 每個細節都再檢查。和 quickly、main points 不符。
looked my notes over again = 再看一次筆記。快速確認主要重點正適合這個片語。
proofread them = 校對筆記。不是檢查拼字或文法。
memorised them = 背熟。比題目需要的程度更強。

falseSynonyms.zh: 重讀這個動作不等於一般的 reread rereading 是動名詞／現在分詞；reread 是動詞原形或過去式拼法之一。詞性和句法位置不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Reread is a verb; rereading can name the activity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 略讀不等於一般的 reread skim 是快速讀取重點，不代表把整份內容重新讀一次。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You may skim a text without rereading it fully.

falseSynonyms.zh: 校對不等於一般的 reread proofread 是為了找拼字、文法、標點或格式錯誤而閱讀；reread 的目的可以只是理解或確認內容。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Proofreading is a special kind of checking; rereading is broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 重寫不等於一般的 reread rewrite 是重新寫一遍或改寫內容，不是重新閱讀。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You reread a draft before you rewrite it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 重複不等於一般的 reread repeat 是再次做同一件事，範圍很廣；若沒有閱讀對象，它不等於 reread。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can repeat an action, but reread specifically means read again.

falseSynonyms.zh: 記住；背熟不等於一般的 reread memorise 的目標是把內容記入記憶；rereading 可能幫助記憶，但兩個動作不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Rereading may help you memorise something.

falseSynonyms.zh: 摘要不等於一般的 reread summarise 是用較短形式表達重點，通常需要先閱讀，但不等於重新閱讀。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You may reread a text before summarising it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 朗讀不等於一般的 reread read aloud 是把文字讀出聲；reread 只表示再讀一次，可以默讀也可以朗讀。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can reread silently or aloud.
